title: Lut Gaya tera bhara ghar fatima
body:
lut gaya tera bhara ghar fatima
sar kahi'n laashe kahi'n par hai pade
bekafan hai aaj lashkar fatima
aagaye lutkar haram jo karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj aayi hai khule sar fatima
haaye wo bemaar e gham zainulleba
qaid se aaye hai'n chhut kar fatima
lashkar-e-kuffar se haq ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
aagaya hur bhi palat kar fatima
ek jhoola aur zainab ki rida
chhin gaye bachchi ke gouhar fatima
aarahi hai ab bhi sarwar ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
aate hai'n ham par bhi pathhar fatima
kis tarha bhai ko apne de kafan
chhin chuki zainab ki chadar fatima
koun hai bewou'n ki aaker le khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
hai na abbas-e-dilawar fatima
khoon aisa phir baha na aaj tak
is zameen e karbala par fatima
dhoond kar asgher ko sughra thak gayi par mila na usko asgher fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar naize pe sar shabbir ka
chain tumko aaye kyu'n kar fatima
kaam deen e haq pe aakhir aagaye
zainabe muztar ke dilbar fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
kya ata hai aapki iqbal par
hogaya nouha mayassar fatima
